draft_memo.title: Assessment of CareBridge Remote Consultations and Patient Satisfaction
draft_memo.body:
CareBridge has experienced a notable increase in the volume of remote consultations, conducting 24,000 sessions in 2025, up from 20,000 in 2024. This growth indicates that remote consultations represented 30% of the total consultations performed by CareBridge in 2025, reflecting a shift towards telehealth services within the organization [P09]. However, the total number of consultations is not specified, which limits the ability to fully contextualize this percentage. The increase in remote consultations may align with broader trends in healthcare, although specific patient preferences are not detailed in the available data.

Patient satisfaction regarding these remote consultations has also shown improvement. A patient survey conducted by CareBridge indicated an 80% satisfaction rate for remote consultations in 2025, which is an increase from 78% in 2024 [P10]. It is crucial to emphasize that the surveys utilized different respondents each year, raising concerns about the comparability of the satisfaction rates. This limitation suggests that while there is an upward trend in satisfaction, the reasons behind this satisfaction are not explicitly captured in the data, making it difficult to ascertain the factors contributing to this increase.

While the data presents a generally positive outlook for CareBridge's remote consultation services, it is essential to acknowledge the limitations of the survey data. The surveys do not account for the costs associated with remote consultations or the specific factors influencing patient satisfaction levels. Additionally, the context of the healthcare landscape, including competition and technological advancements, may also impact patient experiences and perceptions. Overall, while CareBridge appears to be experiencing growth in remote consultations and patient satisfaction, further research is warranted to gain a comprehensive understanding of the factors influencing these trends and to validate the findings reported in the surveys, particularly regarding cost implications and patient preferences.

[P10] CareBridge's patient survey recorded 80% satisfaction for remote consultations in 2025, compared with 78% in 2024, using different respondents each year.

Overall, while CareBridge appears to be experiencing growth in remote consultations and patient satisfaction, further research is warranted to gain a comprehensive understanding of the factors influencing these trends and to validate the findings reported in the surveys, particularly regarding cost implications and patient preferences.

[P10] CareBridge's patient survey recorded 80% satisfaction for remote consultations in 2025, compared with 78% in 2024, using different respondents each year.
